ache.note: A free S-Rank selector box, and past-Nero helping F2P players pick. Then: base characters cost 720 warp pieces in the shop, about 30 limited pulls. A free pick feels like a gift, and it’s also a reason to keep logging in. He says you don’t need to spend much. Much is a lot more than nothing.

videoData.title: 1.2 FREE S-Rank Selector: Best Pick? | Neverness to Everness

textData.text: I break down the free S-Rank standard character selection box from Neverness to Everness patch 1.2 and go character-by-character to help low spenders and F2P players choose the right base S-rank for their teams. I cover Daffodill’s hybrid DPS and break-focused utility, Jiuyuan’s Anima sub-DPS and blossom synergy, Hathor’s Lakshana Remora support, Fadia’s strong healing and survivability, Sakiri’s standout attack buffs, defense debuffs, DoT support, and crowd control, and Baicang’s incantation kit and niche team synergies (especially with Daffodill). I also explain how base characters can be bought in the shop for 720 warp pieces (about 30 limited pulls), and why you don’t need to spend much money to enjoy the game.
